title: Dashboard reliability: every lane in a plan, stale items
goal: The visualizer is reliable: every lane belongs to a plan (the runner enforces it), the Office always shows the plan that is working and switches to new plans and newly running lanes; stale Needs-you items are easy to clear.

waves.name: Wave 1 · Stale items and plan binding
waves.note: drift: age, Older than 2 days group, Mark all handled, ca ack --stale. planbind: the runner puts every lane in a plan; the Office follows the working plan. Contract checks: drift, planbind.

lanes.why: Stale Needs-you items: age, Older than 2 days group, Mark all handled, ca ack --stale, MCP ca_ack stale
Every lane belongs to a plan (runner creates or extends the repo plan); the Office shows the working plan and follows new plans and newly running lanes

next: Merge drift and planbind, run every check
Real test: start a lane with no plan and one with a closed plan, watch the Office and Lanes
Push, sync the skill, screenshots of the Office and Control room

decisions.text: User: lanes always belong to a plan; showing running lanes outside the shown plan is confusing. Reverting that; the runner enforces plan membership instead, and the Office follows the working plan.
Root cause of the missed lane: the lead started drift without a plan right after closing the previous one. Lead mistake, now made impossible by the runner.

risks: Two lanes edit runner/ca.mjs in different functions (drift: cmdAck and help; planbind: runLane and plan helpers): the lead resolves merges.
